## cdf26af5c935
Generator SHA-256:
`c8f050d99cddaf8d25eb2e7c01f105696e1cab028a4a94f0972aea153940f772`.
Rule SHA-256:
`f0bf24a90ea60a5e7fba8acdd8954526fdf107cfd1ae06a31290b82bf4831ef2`.

### A3 — Reproduced default lesson-contract failure
Executed the actual runner with `EXAMPLES_NEEDED=3`, one query, no overrides,
100 lessons per band. Seeds are `_pinned_seed(task, "lesson:<band>", k)`,
k=0..99; start index 11*k. All six cycle-start residues are represented.

| Band | Lessons failing target's own `lesson_identifiable` | Pair checks | Unique inputs within band |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Easy | 16/100 | 400 | 382 |
| Medium | 15/100 | 400 | 391 |
| Hard | 17/100 | 400 | 388 |

Total **48/300 contract failures**; 1200 pair checks, **1091 unique inputs** in
the cross-band union. All 1200 inputs pass the validator and all 1200 actual
Racket outputs agree with one-bounding-box-per-color within this grammar.
These are not 48 incorrect-label episodes. A failing lesson does not necessarily
prove ambiguity against every correct solver; it violates the generator's own
stated teaching criterion.

First failing starts are easy seed 159902071000026/index 231, medium seed
76844440487152/index 33, hard seed 9730119962127/index 33. Each reports:
`demos do not vary from one to multiple independent rectangles`.
Full actual examples and checks are saved in
`checks/counterexamples/A3-first-lessons.json`; all 300 seeds/reasons are in the
audit report. Investigate the three-demo windows beginning in the latter half
of the six-profile cycle before promoting the teaching contract.

### A4 — Domain question, not an in-domain generator defect
The one-bounding-box-per-color rival fits all 4/4 usable canonical pairs and
1200/1200 sampled pairs. An exact 9×9 input with color-2 corners at rows/cols
(1,3) and (5,7) instead represents two separate 3×3 rectangles of the same
color. Canonical Racket fills two rectangles; the rival fills one 7×7 box.
Evidence: `checks/counterexamples/A4.json`.

The target validator **rejects** this input because color 2 occupies eight
cells rather than exactly four; it lies outside the documented per-color
corner grammar and is not emitted by that sampler. Thus no within-domain
counterexample to this rival was found. Choose explicitly whether that narrow
grammar is intentional or repeated colors should become a separate extension.
Do not call this an observed label bug or patch the unrelated task here.

## cdf26af5c935

**Actionable teaching defect.** Generator SHA-256 `c8f050d99cddaf8d25eb2e7c01f105696e1cab028a4a94f0972aea153940f772`, canonical rule hash `f0bf24a90ea6`.

A real production-sampler lesson at difficulty `medium`, seed `76844440487152`, accepted sample indices `33,34,35,36` contains three demonstrations with at least two rectangle colors and a one-rectangle query. The rival “perform the intended per-color fill only when at least two rectangle colors are present; otherwise return the input unchanged” matches all three Racket-labelled demonstrations and disagrees on the query. Every input passes the target validator and belongs to the documented and actual generator domain.

Reproducer and evidence:

- `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/counterexample.json`
- `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/input.json`
- `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/pre_apply.json`
- preparation tool: `checks/audit/reproduce.py`
- command: from `repo`, `python3 ../run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply cdf26af5c935 --input ../checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/input.json --out ../checks/audit/cdf26af5c935/racket.json`

The fresh required-rotation semantic stage independently fails: 2/12 ordinary lessons are unidentifiable (medium and hard cases at `sample_index=33`). See `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935-semantic-rotations/checks/cdf26af5c935_after_semantic_gate.json`. No competitors are declared, so the stage can only report hook reasons; the concrete JSON above supplies the executable rival and differing query.

A secondary maintenance issue is that the target’s task-test stage is not portable: it hard-codes a canonical-data path relative to source depth, so the isolated runtime stops before pytest. See `checks/audit/cdf26af5c935-task-tests/`. This does not invalidate the semantic counterexample.

**Suggested repair, not applied:** make every four-pair lesson include one- and multi-rectangle evidence regardless of start/query position, declare the ≥2-rectangle-only rival, and migrate tests to `reviewer_support.canonical_pairs/find_root`.
